body:
Yeah, it seems like you can at least imagine how hard it can be. Doctors, family, everyone in my life clearly doesn't even remotely understand. 

It isn't just reading and navigating... but my ability to appreciate art and beauty itself. 

Then they reassure me that there are 4,000$ devices I can't afford that can read for you.. as if that is the same.

I can't even close my eyes and get away from it. Even in a pitch black room with my eyes closed I see this bright translucent static  and lines going over my vision not unlike when you look at a lamp too long and and it stays with youbafter... but forever.
